intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Gaithersburg for 2026, and here is what he found: 10 family events, 3 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (the Winter Lights Festival at Seneca Creek State Park) through December 31 (Noon Year's Eve at Gaithersburg Library), with the Jingle Jubilee Tree Lighting (December 4), Santa's Enchanted Visit (December 5), All Aboard with Santa (December 5 and 6) and Cocoa with the Clauses (December 12) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Gaithersburg

  • 10 Christmas events for kids in Gaithersburg
  • 3 free events, including the Jingle Jubilee Tree Lighting (December 4), Light Up the Lakefront at rio and STEM Explorers gingerbread houses (December 5)
  • Meet Santa: Santa's Enchanted Visit (December 5), All Aboard with Santa (December 5 and 6) and Cocoa with the Clauses (December 12)
  • Parades and tree lightings: the Jingle Jubilee Tree Lighting (December 4)
  • Trains: All Aboard with Santa at the Gaithersburg Community Museum (December 5 and 6)
  • Season: November 27 to December 31

Planning a bigger day out? Gaithersburg families also use our guides to Christmas activities for kids in Washington, DC and Germantown.
